title: Enterprise Multi-Tenant KMS / DMS Product Requirements

modules.title: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
modules.blurb: Every subsidiary is a separately governed security scope. The holding company administers tenant existence and permitted policy baselines, not an implicit universal decryption capability.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Model parent holding company, subsidiaries, divisions, departments, teams and optional project workspaces; support future nested groups without changing authorization semantics.
features.control: Relationships are scoped; no subsidiary inherits another subsidiary's members or data.
features.acceptance: Create a group with 10 subsidiaries and verify independent organizational trees and document inventories.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Create a subsidiary from a policy template, assign administrators, select storage residency, branding, default taxonomy and encryption mode.
features.control: Provisioning is idempotent and cannot reuse a retired tenant's identifiers or keys.
features.acceptance: A new subsidiary is operational with its own administrators and an empty private repository.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Suspend sign-in, editing, sharing and exports without automatically destroying retained records; close tenants only via approved disposition workflow.
features.control: Retention and legal holds override closure or deletion.
features.acceptance: Suspension denies access immediately while preserving compliant records and audit evidence.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Set configurable storage, API request, background job and user limits for each subsidiary and aggregate group budgets.
features.control: Per-tenant throttling prevents noisy neighbors from exhausting shared resources.
features.acceptance: Tenant A reaches its limit without degrading tenant B or compromising access rules.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Let each subsidiary administer its own users, groups, roles, categories, folders, workflows and settings within group policy bounds.
features.control: Group administrators cannot silently elevate content access or view encryption keys.
features.acceptance: A subsidiary admin changes its own settings without affecting another subsidiary.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: The holding company defines mandatory minimum policies such as MFA, encryption, retention floors and prohibited sharing modes.
features.control: Subsidiaries may strengthen but not weaken locked global controls.
features.acceptance: Attempts to relax a locked group control fail with a specific audit entry.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Create explicit cross-entity workspaces with named participating organizations, custodians, scope, expiry and document-specific entitlements.
features.control: Each participating tenant authorizes sharing; encrypted keys are distributed only to authorized recipients.
features.acceptance: A project member can open approved materials but no other participating subsidiary files.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: For a person with memberships in multiple entities, provide a clear active-tenant switcher and context indicators throughout the UI.
features.control: Server derives tenant context from verified membership, never from an untrusted request field alone.
features.acceptance: Changing the selected tenant cannot expose results or cached content from the previous tenant.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Separate files, cache objects, queue tasks, search indexes, logs and backup inventory using enforceable tenant scopes.
features.control: Direct object references and cache keys are checked for correct tenant binding.
features.acceptance: Automated tenant crossover tests cannot list, read, edit or export foreign objects.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Export authorized documents, versions, metadata, permissions, audit excerpts and signed manifests into a documented interchange format.
features.control: Export requires privileged approval and respects holds, encryption modes and privacy limits.
features.acceptance: Export can be validated and reimported into a clean deployment without loss of authorized metadata.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Record registered business name, legal identifiers, jurisdictions, retention owner, legal contacts and approved admin domains.
features.control: Sensitive identifiers are protected and changes to legal ownership require elevated approval.
features.acceptance: Change history and legal-entity version are retained for every tenant.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Give holding auditors permitted aggregate metrics across subsidiaries: count, usage, policy compliance, incident status and workflow bottlenecks.
features.control: Report totals do not disclose document titles or contents absent explicit authorization.
features.acceptance: Holding dashboard displays counts without permitting click-through into unauthorized content.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Allow each tenant to select approved geographic storage/processing regions and enforce placement for data, backups, search, AI and metadata.
features.control: Cross-region failover is disabled when it would violate residency rules.
features.acceptance: Data location audit proves configured locations and blocks unapproved region processing.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Support subsidiary rename, merger, split, transfer or liquidation through an explicit migration and consent process.
features.control: No silent transfer of records, keys or rights; preservation schedules remain intact.
features.acceptance: Trial migration produces an impact report and reversible staging before cutover.

modules.title: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
modules.blurb: Authorization is enforced by a dedicated policy decision point across every application and API request. WordPress roles are integration conveniences, not the security boundary.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Represent a person once in the identity service and create independent active, suspended or expired memberships in any number of subsidiaries.
features.control: Memberships have tenant-specific roles, entitlements and expiry.
features.acceptance: Deactivating tenant A membership does not affect an approved membership in tenant B.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Allow admins to name roles, select granular capabilities and publish versioned role templates for their own subsidiary.
features.control: New roles default to no privileges; self-escalation is blocked.
features.acceptance: Create an HR Reviewer role and verify only selected operations are allowed.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Permit reusable role bundles but show the full effective permission set before assigning.
features.control: Privileges never imply cross-tenant access; privilege amplification via nested roles is rejected.
features.acceptance: Role editor identifies and blocks conflicting or unauthorized capability combinations.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Support directory-synced and locally managed teams, dynamic groups and project-specific memberships.
features.control: Dynamic membership rules are evaluated securely and require approval for privileged scopes.
features.acceptance: Removing a member from a group revokes future access and triggers key policy actions.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Grant view, comment, edit, manage, share, print, download, export and delete independently to users, groups and roles.
features.control: Explicit deny overrides grants, and absent permission means deny.
features.acceptance: A viewer permitted to preview but not download receives denial for every export endpoint.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Combine role grants with classification, owner, department, device posture, location, network and time conditions.
features.control: Context claims are trusted only from authenticated sources and reevaluated on sensitive operations.
features.acceptance: A confidential document cannot be opened outside permitted contextual conditions.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Allow inheritance from parent folders, with controlled exceptions and a visual explanation of effective rights.
features.control: Child restrictions may tighten defaults; conflicts resolve deterministically and fail closed.
features.acceptance: Moving a document between folders recalculates rights without exposing it mid-transaction.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Provide a who-can-access-what tester showing allow/deny decisions and the applicable rules without displaying protected content.
features.control: Only authorized admins can inspect policy traces and simulations are audited.
features.acceptance: Admin enters user, document and action and receives a reproducible decision trace.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Let users request access with a purpose and expiry; route to document owners and designated access approvers.
features.control: Requester cannot approve own request; high-sensitivity grants may require two independent approvers.
features.acceptance: An approved grant expires automatically and leaves a complete audit trail.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Support start/end dates, one-time grants and session-bound access for temporary projects and external specialists.
features.control: Expired grants are denied before file streaming or key distribution.
features.acceptance: Access immediately fails after expiry even when old links are reused.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Prevent conflicting combinations such as creator and final approver or custodian and unilateral disposition authorizer.
features.control: Conflicts are checked at assignment and at action time, including delegated permissions.
features.acceptance: Workflow fails closed when an actor attempts both conflicting steps.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Delegate limited user, folder or workflow administration for a date range without granting content read or key access.
features.control: Delegation scope is narrow, explicit, revocable and logged.
features.acceptance: Delegated manager can update permitted assignments but cannot view confidential files.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Provide highly restricted emergency access to managed-mode resources when explicitly allowed, with independent approval and incident ticket linkage.
features.control: Zero-Knowledge content has no magical break-glass; recovery requires its separate approved key-recovery design.
features.acceptance: Emergency grants are time-bound, alerted and reviewed afterward.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Issue machine identities for imports, scans, connectors and jobs with narrowly scoped operations and credentials.
features.control: No shared superuser tokens or unscoped background execution.
features.acceptance: Revoking a workload identity immediately disables its operations and produces audit events.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Report all privileged accounts, public/external grants, inherited policies, stale accounts and exceptions by subsidiary.
features.control: Queries redact private names/titles where reporting actor lacks rights.
features.acceptance: Quarterly entitlement review generates an actionable report with approvals.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Assign managers or custodians to recertify access to sensitive folders and users on defined schedules.
features.control: Unreviewed rights expire or enter restriction according to policy.
features.acceptance: Certification cycle tracks attestations, overdue reviews and revocations.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Recheck permissions when generating download grants, streaming files, applying versions and delivering queued content.
features.control: Revoked access wins over stale caches or background jobs.
features.acceptance: Revoke rights during a large download and verify the system blocks subsequent authorized fetches as designed.

modules.title: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
modules.blurb: Identity security covers internal staff, multi-subsidiary users, contractors and service principals, with phishing-resistant authentication on sensitive operations.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Integrate OIDC and optionally SAML identity providers per tenant or central enterprise directory.
features.control: Validate audience, issuer, signature, expiration and tenant binding; reject insecure SSO fallbacks.
features.acceptance: Single sign-on creates only memberships explicitly mapped from trusted identity claims.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Support phishing-resistant passkeys or hardware-backed MFA for privileged and sensitive roles; provide secondary enrollment controls.
features.control: Enforce step-up MFA for exports, privileged changes and recovery.
features.acceptance: A privileged action without the required second factor is rejected.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Support explicitly approved local accounts where SSO is unavailable, with Argon2id password hashing and secure recovery.
features.control: No plaintext or reversible password storage; disable local fallback when tenant policy forbids it.
features.acceptance: Password resets invalidate prior sessions and trigger notification.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Provision and deprovision accounts via SCIM or approved directory sync, with offboarding across tenant memberships.
features.control: Suspended users cannot use API tokens, file clients or queued links.
features.acceptance: Directory deactivation blocks all future access within configured synchronization targets.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Use short-lived access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, device-bound sessions where possible and revocation registries.
features.control: Tokens are scoped to user, client and tenant context; replay is detected.
features.acceptance: A revoked token is denied across all protected services within the defined revocation window.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Support device registration, posture attestation from integrations and conditional rules for managed/unmanaged devices.
features.control: Device health or certificate state never grants authorization alone.
features.acceptance: Download is blocked on an unmanaged device for classifications requiring managed endpoints.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Users and admins can view active sessions, last authentication, client type, device and revoke sessions.
features.control: Display only appropriately minimized device metadata.
features.acceptance: Logout-all revokes web, mobile and desktop refresh sessions.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Require step-up checks for anomalous sessions, unusual travel and highly sensitive operations.
features.control: Risk scoring is explainable and must avoid sole automated irrevocable employee sanctions.
features.acceptance: High-risk export triggers additional verification and security event.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Require separate admin elevation, limited-time privileged sessions and approvals for critical key/recovery operations.
features.control: Routine browsing identities do not inherit permanent unrestricted privilege.
features.acceptance: Elevation expires and is traceable to the original user and approval.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Apply rate limits, anti-enumeration measures, bot defenses and suspicious login alerts.
features.control: Security challenges must remain accessible and avoid disclosing valid usernames.
features.acceptance: Password spraying simulation triggers throttling and alerts without cross-tenant leakage.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Register cryptographic device public keys, allow user verification and show key fingerprints for confidential collaboration.
features.control: Device keys generated and protected by trusted clients; no private keys are sent to WordPress.
features.acceptance: Adding a device requires strong authentication and sends a notification to existing trusted devices.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Define documented user recovery, lost device, staff departure and emergency offboarding processes.
features.control: Recovery is distinct for managed and zero-knowledge modes; approvals and delays are configurable.
features.acceptance: A lost-device drill demonstrates secure recovery without bypassing protected-mode rules.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Allow time-limited guest login via trusted external identity or passwordless invitation with verification.
features.control: Tenant admins constrain invited domains and guest visibility; no anonymous group membership.
features.acceptance: Guest only sees explicitly shared resources and is removed on expiry.

modules.title: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
modules.blurb: A secure enterprise repository must cover the complete file lifecycle, diverse intake channels and heterogeneous content without bypassing authorization.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Support secure single-file upload and authorized download with filenames, MIME detection, transfer integrity and progress feedback.
features.control: Reject dangerous content/types by policy; do not expose directly addressable public media URLs.
features.acceptance: A user can upload then retrieve a permitted file and a denied user cannot read it.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Use encrypted chunked uploads, restart support, integrity manifests and recoverable interrupted transfers.
features.control: Temporary chunks are tenant-scoped, encrypted or plaintext-free, and expire automatically.
features.acceptance: Simulate lost connection during a large file transfer and resume without corruption.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Handle PDF, Office documents, images, text, email archives and approved CAD/media types as opaque files if rendering unavailable.
features.control: File type detection relies on content analysis, not only extension; unsupported previews are clearly indicated.
features.acceptance: Each allowlisted format stores and downloads with verified byte integrity.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Create nested libraries, categories and folders with controlled naming, descriptions, sorting and shortcut references.
features.control: No cross-tenant folder linking except via explicit sharing objects.
features.acceptance: Moving folders preserves IDs and recalculates inherited rights.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Provide subsidiary templates for policies, contracts, forms, meeting minutes and controlled document numbering.
features.control: Template permissions and versions govern generated documents; sensitive variables stay scoped.
features.acceptance: Approved template can generate a new versioned draft with mandatory fields.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Assign unique immutable document IDs, title, owner, creator, tenant, category, status and classification at intake.
features.control: Server validates mandatory metadata and approved storage/crypto mode before committing.
features.acceptance: Missing required metadata blocks publication without orphaned files.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Ingest folders or multiple files with a mapping preview for names, labels, owners and metadata.
features.control: Batch actions do not bypass per-file virus, rights, quota or encryption checks.
features.acceptance: Bulk operation reports per-document success and recoverable failures.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Convert authorized inbound messages and attachments into documents with thread metadata and source provenance.
features.control: Approved domain routing, attachment policies and malware scanning apply; avoid storing confidential messages in logs.
features.acceptance: Message is ingested once with traceable source and tenant identity.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Accept scan jobs with OCR staging and metadata capture from approved scanners or capture stations.
features.control: Scan processing for Zero-Knowledge content occurs on trusted endpoints only.
features.acceptance: Scanned pages produce a protected document and operator review queue.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Model Draft, In Review, Approved, Published, Superseded, Archived and Disposed with tenant-defined transition rules.
features.control: Every transition checks document and workflow permission and produces audit evidence.
features.acceptance: Unauthorized transition fails and users see only allowed next actions.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Assign business owner, steward and backup custodians with escalation policies.
features.control: Document ownership does not automatically override classification or tenant isolation.
features.acceptance: Owner departure triggers reassignment workflow without orphaning document governance.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Distinguish move, new copy and metadata shortcut; explain impacts on history, security, ownership and storage.
features.control: Copy creates a new identifier and new security evaluation; cross-tenant copy needs consent and key handling.
features.acceptance: Audit identifies whether operation moved, copied or merely linked content.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Support reversible soft deletion with a retention window and controlled restore to same or permitted new location.
features.control: Holds and immutable records prohibit unauthorized purge; restores do not reinstate revoked grants.
features.acceptance: Restored file retains provenance while following current permission policies.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Detect likely duplicate content and optional matching metadata without revealing protected document existence across tenants.
features.control: Global deduplication must not create equality or membership side channels for confidential content.
features.acceptance: Duplicate hints appear only for files the user can already access.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Record authenticated hashes or integrity manifests for encrypted objects and versions and verify them on fetch.
features.control: Do not expose sensitive equality hashes to unauthorized users.
features.acceptance: Modified ciphertext or a missing chunk causes a clear integrity failure and alert.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Allow records for physical archives, external system references, boxes and paper documents without uploading a digital file.
features.control: External links do not inherit implicit external credentials.
features.acceptance: Create and track a physical-record item with retention and ownership.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Build ordered virtual binders for board packs, cases, projects, annual reports or audit evidence.
features.control: A binder grants no implicit access to its protected members.
features.acceptance: Recipient sees only documents individually authorized within a shared dossier.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Generate patterns by tenant, department, class, year and sequence with collision-proof issuance.
features.control: Numbers remain immutable after publication and never reused after deletion.
features.acceptance: Concurrent numbering requests issue unique sequential references per policy.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Configure limits by organization, collection and classification with safe defaults and clear error messages.
features.control: Client and server enforce limits; chunk sessions cannot evade size checks.
features.acceptance: Attempt to upload forbidden type or oversized file fails at final validation.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Add review dates, expiry dates, reminders and mandatory periodic policy-document recertification.
features.control: Expiration changes discoverability and use rights according to explicit tenant policy.
features.acceptance: Reviewer receives escalation and superseded policy is removed from current guidance.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Render previews only when authorized, without persistent unprotected public thumbnails or conversion caches.
features.control: Zero-Knowledge previews are generated locally; managed previews are isolated and ephemeral.
features.acceptance: Protected preview cannot be fetched by URL after permission revocation.

features.module: Document capture, storage and lifecycle
features.requirement: Allow permanent derivative redacted versions for external sharing, with preview-and-verify workflow.
features.control: Redaction must remove underlying text, metadata and hidden layers; preserve original under separate rights.
features.acceptance: Automated extraction of redacted output cannot recover removed content.

modules.title: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
modules.blurb: Discovery should emphasize accurate classification, subject-matter context, permission trimming and safe handling of encrypted content.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Define structured fields per document type: text, date, number, select, reference, currency, user, jurisdiction and controlled lists.
features.control: Schema validation occurs server-side and confidential fields follow field-level access policies.
features.acceptance: Schema edits include migration preview and preservation of existing versions.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Require fields based on category, lifecycle state, sensitivity, source and owning department.
features.control: Untrusted client values cannot bypass conditional validation.
features.acceptance: A contract cannot be approved without counterparty and effective date fields.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Create hierarchical taxonomies, synonyms, aliases and deprecated terms with governance approval.
features.control: Taxonomy changes are versioned and do not relax access controls.
features.acceptance: Deprecated tag resolves to a valid replacement without losing historic searches.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Let users build dynamic views from filters without moving files or changing rights.
features.control: Result sets are always trimmed by current authorization.
features.acceptance: Smart view updates as metadata changes and excludes newly forbidden documents.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Search titles, tags, dates, types, users, references and relationships with Boolean filters and facets.
features.control: Query timing, autocomplete and facets must not disclose inaccessible content counts or titles.
features.acceptance: Two users receive appropriately different filtered results for same query.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Index authorized parsed plaintext inside separately protected services and filter results before response.
features.control: Index at rest and transport are protected; no unencrypted WordPress search replication.
features.acceptance: Rights revocation removes document from search results within the defined propagation SLA.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Offer client-side per-user encrypted indexes, opt-in safe metadata indexes or limited blind-index design with documented leakage.
features.control: Never falsely advertise arbitrary server-side plaintext search in Zero-Knowledge Mode.
features.acceptance: User can retrieve a protected document without service-side access to readable full text.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Extract text and selected fields for managed-mode scans with operator correction and confidence scores.
features.control: OCR of zero-knowledge files happens only on trusted clients or after explicitly authorized processing-mode change.
features.acceptance: A low-confidence extracted field remains unapproved until reviewed.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Support Unicode normalization, language-aware tokenization, stemming where reliable and localized synonyms.
features.control: Search terms and user-specific indexes are scoped and logged without exposing confidential queries.
features.acceptance: Search returns expected results in all supported scripts on test corpora.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Link contracts to amendments, policies to procedures, board decisions to supporting evidence and documents to business entities.
features.control: Relationship existence is filtered for both endpoints; cannot disclose hidden targets.
features.acceptance: Unauthorized referenced record shows a restricted placeholder, not its title.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Maintain typed relations among documents, people, processes, projects, decisions and records.
features.control: Inferred graph edges respect original access labels and tenant isolation.
features.acceptance: A graph query never reveals protected nodes through degree or auto-complete leakage.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Suggest merging overlapping articles or competing current policies based on permitted corpora.
features.control: Similarity computations respect security mode and must not leak inaccessible embeddings or snippets.
features.acceptance: Suggestions include rationale and require human approval before consolidation.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Provide business synonyms, field weights, recency rules and boosts for approved canonical guidance.
features.control: Protected records never become visible because of relevance or popularity boosts.
features.acceptance: Authorized administrator can compare ranking changes using a safe test dataset.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Save user favorites, recent queries and collections with clear private-versus-shared controls.
features.control: Private histories stay user-scoped, encryptable and subject to privacy retention rules.
features.acceptance: Clearing personal history removes it from active interfaces and eligible stores.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Track original source, capture time, imported system ID, transformations, approvals and evidence chain.
features.control: Provenance records are append-only where required and signed where appropriate.
features.acceptance: Auditor verifies a document's chain from ingestion through publication.

features.module: Metadata, taxonomy and information discovery
features.requirement: Show verified owner, reviewed date, citation status, freshness, confidentiality and canonical source markers.
features.control: Quality scores are not treated as access permissions or legal compliance certification.
features.acceptance: Stale information is flagged while historical approved versions remain accessible to authorized users.

modules.title: Editing, collaboration and version control
modules.blurb: Collaboration must retain precise version lineage and prevent comments, history or derived artifacts from escaping document-level security.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Store new encrypted objects for each committed version with author, timestamp, parent version and reason.
features.control: Old versions inherit current access restrictions unless explicitly stricter historical rules apply.
features.acceptance: Auditor can verify unchanged prior bytes and full version lineage.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Support draft revisions, approved major releases and semantic numbering configured by document class.
features.control: Only authorized approvers can create an official published major version.
features.acceptance: A reviewer distinguishes draft v1.2 from approved v2.0.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Compare text, metadata and supported document formats and present changes with citations to versions.
features.control: Comparison only processes content the actor can decrypt; zero-knowledge comparison runs in trusted client.
features.acceptance: Authorized user sees clear added/removed changes between two chosen versions.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Support optional lock with editor, expiry, reason and controlled admin override for formats that cannot merge.
features.control: Override is audited, owner notified and never bypasses read authorization.
features.acceptance: A second editor cannot overwrite an active locked revision silently.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Permit safe text and knowledge-page editing; integrate Office-compatible editors in approved trust and encryption modes.
features.control: Third-party editor is prohibited from seeing zero-knowledge material without explicit trust-model change.
features.acceptance: Edited draft saves a new version while retaining prior versions.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Add concurrent editing, presence and conflict resolution where a compatible collaboration engine exists.
features.control: Ephemeral presence and editor state are tenant-scoped and encrypted as required.
features.acceptance: Two permitted users can edit the same knowledge page without data loss.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Anchor discussions to text regions, pages or versions, with mentions, resolve status and thread ownership.
features.control: Comments inherit strict content rights and are hidden from recipients lacking file access.
features.acceptance: Commenter can resolve own permitted thread; unauthorized user cannot enumerate threads.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Support personal and group annotations, stamps and review marks on supported formats.
features.control: Personal annotations stay private unless deliberately shared.
features.acceptance: Annotation remains anchored to the correct document version.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Let reviewers propose edits without changing authoritative content; owners accept or reject suggestions.
features.control: Sensitive changes may require reapproval and cannot overwrite signed released records.
features.acceptance: Rejected suggestion leaves an audit trail but no document mutation.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Assign named reviewers, deadlines, parallel review groups and due-date escalations.
features.control: Assignments do not automatically grant plaintext access beyond the workflow's approved grant.
features.acceptance: Late reviewers appear in escalation queue with status and overdue time.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Let users follow authorized documents, owners, categories and policy updates with adjustable notification frequency.
features.control: Notification content is limited to recipients' rights at delivery time.
features.acceptance: Revoking access stops future sensitive notifications and deep links.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Apply dynamic user, tenant, date and classification watermarks to managed previews and exports when policy allows.
features.control: Watermarks deter casual misuse but do not prevent screenshots; zero-knowledge labels must be applied by trusted client.
features.acceptance: Rendered export contains the required mark, without affecting underlying master bytes.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Queue offline edits with explicit reauthentication and merge/conflict resolution on reconnect.
features.control: Offline caches are encrypted, time-bound and removed on remote wipe where possible.
features.acceptance: Competing offline revisions create a conflict queue rather than overwriting.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Collect workflow approvals bound to document hash, version, actor and time; optionally integrate legally appropriate digital signatures.
features.control: Approval acknowledgment is not automatically a legally qualified electronic signature.
features.acceptance: Any post-approval edit invalidates the version's approval state.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Support structured Q&A, decision threads and reactions for team knowledge pages and permitted documents.
features.control: Moderation, retention and access controls apply to discussion content.
features.acceptance: A restricted discussion cannot be surfaced in global activity feed.

features.module: Editing, collaboration and version control
features.requirement: Show who is currently viewing or editing permitted items, with privacy-aware optional presence controls.
features.control: Cross-tenant presence is hidden unless explicit joint workspace grant exists.
features.acceptance: Presence disappears after session timeout and does not disclose private activity.

modules.title: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
modules.blurb: Add first-class knowledge objects so the platform becomes more than a file repository.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Create wiki pages with headings, tables, code, callouts, attachments, embedded authorized references and versioned changes.
features.control: Page transclusions and linked attachments must undergo separate access checks.
features.acceptance: A viewer cannot reveal restricted attachments through an authorized parent page.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Establish subsidiary, department, project and cross-company spaces with ownership and published navigation trees.
features.control: Space membership does not override document classification or individual deny rules.
features.acceptance: A team publishes a knowledge space without exposing hidden departmental records.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Provide reusable SOP, policy, runbook, onboarding, FAQ, meeting decision and incident postmortem templates.
features.control: Templates carry required classification and approval defaults.
features.acceptance: New page inherits correct fields and review cycle from chosen template.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Support question-answer articles, recommended solutions, symptoms, product versions and resolution feedback.
features.control: Published answers must link to approved source documents where policy requires.
features.acceptance: Search retrieves verified FAQ and shows its last review date.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Index opt-in expertise, document stewards and team responsibilities with controlled visibility.
features.control: Personal data is minimized and respects privacy settings.
features.acceptance: Authorized user can find a responsible expert for a category without viewing private personnel records.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Mark approved, owner-reviewed guidance as official, with renewal and supersession rules.
features.control: Only a designated approver can certify official content.
features.acceptance: Search ranks official guidance and visibly warns about stale drafts.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Curate sequential documents, lessons and knowledge checklists for onboarding or role-specific learning.
features.control: Assignment never unlocks documents outside the learner's effective rights.
features.acceptance: Learner progress records completions without adding unauthorized document grants.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Send controlled policy acknowledgments, reminders and evidence of reading/acceptance tied to exact versions.
features.control: Access or acknowledgement must not be fabricated by administrators; attestation may require MFA.
features.acceptance: Report identifies who acknowledged policy version X and who remains overdue.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Permit draft suggestions, expert review and moderated contributions by approved teams.
features.control: Contributor cannot publish into official spaces without required review.
features.acceptance: Accepted contribution shows attribution and approval history.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Collect missing-answer requests, thumbs-up/down, problem reports and editorial suggestions.
features.control: Feedback reports suppress private user content unless reviewers are authorized.
features.acceptance: Knowledge owner receives prioritized backlog of unanswered topics.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Track board and management decisions, rationale, votes where permitted, accountable owner and linked implementation tasks.
features.control: Confidential decision records use special classification and approval.
features.acceptance: Decision can be traced to meeting, evidence and superseding decisions.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Connect policies, procedures, controls, forms, risks and departmental owners into navigable maps.
features.control: Links display only authorized targets and do not leak hidden titles.
features.acceptance: A policy owner can see all permitted dependent procedures affected by a revision.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Support draft, validate, publish, review, retire and archival stages specific to articles and procedures.
features.control: Stale or withdrawn material is not presented as current guidance.
features.acceptance: Published page expires into review queue and stale marker is visible.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Link translated versions to a canonical source, track per-language approval, drift and update requests.
features.control: Translation may require independent legal review and does not inherit authorization exceptions.
features.acceptance: Updating source flags translations needing review without silently changing them.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Provide curated homepages for functions and roles with recently changed policies, tasks and recommended knowledge.
features.control: Every widget is permission trimmed and tenant bound.
features.acceptance: Two users in same subsidiary see only their permitted content blocks.

features.module: Knowledge base, wiki and organizational learning
features.requirement: Report orphaned pages, broken links, duplicate guidance, staleness, unanswered questions and missing custodians.
features.control: Diagnostic reports are scoped to administrator entitlements.
features.acceptance: Monthly content health report produces an owner-actionable backlog.

modules.title: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
modules.blurb: Workflows govern how documents move between creators, reviewers, approvers, publishers, records managers and external counterparties.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Build versioned no-code processes from start, task, branch, timer, integration and approval nodes.
features.control: A published workflow is immutable for existing runs or migrated with explicit controls.
features.acceptance: Two workflow versions execute reproducibly against their own definitions.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Configure ordered approvals, quorum thresholds, unanimity or majority decisions with escalation rules.
features.control: Creator and approver separation is enforced where mandated.
features.acceptance: Parallel board review completes only when configured quorum is met.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Route contracts by value, risk, legal jurisdiction, department, counterparty or classification.
features.control: Routing rules are evaluated on trusted server-side metadata and cannot be altered by unauthorized actors.
features.acceptance: Test values route to expected approval lane without exposing other departments' queues.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Supply reusable finance, HR, board, procurement, policy and legal approval templates with subsidiary overrides.
features.control: Global minimum sign-offs cannot be bypassed by tenant customizations.
features.acceptance: Tenant customizes SLA but cannot remove mandatory legal approval.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Give users a consolidated tenant-aware task inbox with due date, priority, document context and actions.
features.control: A task alone does not grant document plaintext access without an approved temporary grant.
features.acceptance: Unapproved user sees no file content while assigned tasks respect authorized context.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Define business calendars, reminders, timeouts, delegations and escalation paths with public holidays per tenant.
features.control: Escalation must not silently override least privilege or approve by timeout.
features.acceptance: Overdue task escalates once with traceable notification and no duplicate assignment.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Record actor, authentication assurance, version hash, decision, comment, timestamp and policy version.
features.control: Evidence is tamper-evident; approving an out-of-date version is blocked.
features.acceptance: Report reconstructs exactly who approved the published bytes.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Assign substitutes for leave and emergencies with role limits, start/end dates and segregation-of-duties checks.
features.control: Substitute cannot exceed delegator entitlements and approvals remain attributable.
features.acceptance: Substitute handles one permitted task while forbidden approvals remain blocked.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Return documents to authors with structured rejection reasons, preserving the prior approval path and comments.
features.control: Material revision invalidates affected approvals according to policy.
features.acceptance: Rejected draft returns to correct state and new version requires reapproval.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Set category, classification, retention, naming and notification values from approved deterministic rules.
features.control: Rule execution runs under restricted service identity and logs before/after changes.
features.acceptance: Workflow applies metadata and rejects a rule that violates locked policy.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Trigger calls to approved ERP, CRM, ticketing or messaging integrations with retries and idempotency.
features.control: No secrets or decrypted sensitive payloads leave protected boundary without explicit connector permission.
features.acceptance: Failed callback retries safely without duplicate invoices or records.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Display process map, state, blockers, age, responsible users and historical transitions.
features.control: Monitors cannot access content they do not otherwise hold rights to.
features.acceptance: Tenant manager diagnoses overdue process without revealing another tenant's tasks.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Support controlled bulk decisions for low-risk items with per-item review evidence and previews.
features.control: High-risk classes or legal attestations disallow blind bulk approval.
features.acceptance: Mixed authorization batch processes only authorized rows and reports denials.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Integrate approved e-signature providers with secure document dispatch and return of signed originals and audit certificates.
features.control: Jurisdiction-specific legal validity and identity assurance must be configured, not assumed.
features.acceptance: A signature packet returns cryptographically matched signed file and evidence record.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Publish structured request forms feeding policy-controlled queues, with conditional fields and attachments.
features.control: Submissions have anti-spam, validation, tenant routing, malware scanning and privacy notices.
features.acceptance: A finance request generates a correctly classified draft with assigned reviewer.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Group documents, parties, deadlines, decisions and tasks into auditable matter or project cases.
features.control: Matter-based ethical walls deny access regardless of general department membership.
features.acceptance: Project closure archives its record set without purging held documents.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Measure cycle time, rejection reasons, approval bottlenecks, completion and policy exceptions.
features.control: Analytics are aggregated and access-controlled to avoid personnel surveillance misuse.
features.acceptance: Dashboard highlights bottleneck using reproducible workflow history.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Offer dry-run test fixtures for workflow branches, calendars, role checks and side effects before publication.
features.control: Simulation never sends real data to third parties or alters real records.
features.acceptance: New rule passes predefined scenarios before administrator can publish.

features.module: Workflow engine, approvals and business process automation
features.requirement: Document and approve time-limited exceptions to business procedures with accountable owner and risk acceptance.
features.control: Locked security boundaries cannot be exempted by ordinary workflow.
features.acceptance: Exception automatically expires and is included in oversight reporting.

modules.title: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
modules.blurb: Records management enforces preservation, disposition and defensible evidence without conflating archives with backups.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Define record series, business function, legal basis, custodian, cutoff triggers and retention durations per jurisdiction.
features.control: Record schedules have versioned approvals and subsidiary-specific policy restrictions.
features.acceptance: An HR file and a board minute receive different retention classes automatically.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Declare a final version as a controlled record and prevent unauthorized editing, overwriting or premature deletion.
features.control: Record lock is enforced by storage, authorization and workflow, not a UI toggle alone.
features.acceptance: Attempted alteration of a locked record fails and generates evidence.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Start retention on contract expiry, employment termination, case closure, fiscal year end or other verified event.
features.control: Events are recorded with provenance and cannot be backdated casually.
features.acceptance: Retention countdown starts only after validated triggering event.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Evaluate global floor, tenant policy, record class, legal holds and applicable jurisdiction simultaneously.
features.control: Preserve the longest applicable lawful hold; explicit precedence rules are documented.
features.acceptance: Conflicting rules yield reproducible retention and disposition decisions.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Suspend deletion and relevant modification for matters, custodians, folders, documents and search-preserved scopes.
features.control: Creation and release require authorized legal actions with protected audit trails.
features.acceptance: Held record cannot be purged even by tenant administrator.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Notify custodians, manage acknowledgments, reminders and hold release evidence.
features.control: Notices use minimum necessary case detail and protect attorney-privileged information.
features.acceptance: Custodian action history is retained for a test legal hold.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Queue eligible records for owner/legal approval before deletion, archival transfer or long-term preservation.
features.control: Records under hold or appeal cannot enter irreversible deletion.
features.acceptance: Two approved reviewers authorize eligible disposition while blocked items remain intact.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Produce tamper-evident certificates describing record identity, schedule, reviewers, action time and integrity manifest.
features.control: Certificates minimize confidential names while preserving evidentiary authenticity.
features.acceptance: Auditor verifies a disposition certificate against audit log and executed job.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Optionally use compliant immutable object storage for designated records, backups and evidence.
features.control: Retention locks are provisioned before content exposure and changes respect platform constraints.
features.acceptance: Unauthorized API overwrite and deletion of locked object fail.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Preview dates, overlaps, trigger sources and affected file counts when policies change.
features.control: Preview cannot reveal documents inaccessible to the requestor.
features.acceptance: Policy change produces impact estimate and approval gate before activation.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Move inactive records to lower-cost archives while preserving IDs, holds, integrity, authorized retrieval and geographic policy.
features.control: Retrieval requests recheck current identity, access and decryption entitlements.
features.acceptance: Archived record can be restored for legal review within a defined SLA.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Group holds, preserved files, custodians, matter timelines and review decisions in restricted investigation workspaces.
features.control: Ethical walls prevent normal tenant admins from accessing confidential legal cases.
features.acceptance: Matter team sees only designated records and a complete collection ledger.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Perform access-controlled collections across permitted records with date, metadata and content filters where processing mode allows.
features.control: Zero-knowledge materials require authorized trusted-client participation for content review.
features.acceptance: eDiscovery package lists exact versions, hashes, custody events and omitted encrypted items.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Append verifiable receipt, transfer, processing, signature and retrieval events to an evidence ledger.
features.control: Timestamp and signatures rely on independent trusted sources and rotation policies.
features.acceptance: Altered custody record is detected during external verification.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Route authorized personal-data erasure requests through applicable retention and litigation exceptions.
features.control: Deletion never bypasses valid legal hold; requester receives accurate exception explanation.
features.acceptance: Approved erasure deletes eligible copies through tracked lifecycle and reports remaining lawful holds.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.feature: Retention for comments, messages and AI artifacts
features.requirement: Govern discussions, generated summaries, OCR, caches, vector indexes and workflow evidence, not only document binaries.
features.control: Derived data cannot outlive source restrictions without independent legal retention basis.
features.acceptance: Disposing a document triggers all eligible derived-data deletion tasks.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Track physical box locations, checkouts, destruction vendors, barcode transfers and scanned surrogates.
features.control: Physical location metadata is confidential and all custody actions are authenticated.
features.acceptance: Paper record movement generates signed or attributable custody events.

features.module: Records governance, retention, legal hold and eDiscovery
features.requirement: Publish effective policy registers, superseded versions, attestation records and regulatory reference mappings.
features.control: Historical policy text cannot be relabeled current after withdrawal.
features.acceptance: User can find current policy and see its effective and supersession dates.

modules.title: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
modules.blurb: The architecture must differentiate encryption at rest, managed decryption services and zero-knowledge client-side access. No security claim is stronger than the actual key boundary.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Support Managed Secure Mode and Zero-Knowledge Mode with different processing, search, recovery and collaboration contracts.
features.control: Mode may not downgrade silently; conversions require risk notice, rights and audited re-encryption workflow.
features.acceptance: Test each mode's documented capabilities and deny unsupported server-side operations.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Deliver zero-knowledge document viewer and key operations from a separately controlled, strongly authenticated application origin or signed desktop/mobile package.
features.control: Compromised WordPress HTML, plugins or scripts cannot receive client private keys or plaintext via shared origin.
features.acceptance: Red-team control of WordPress cannot use its scripts or API token to decrypt protected ciphertext.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Generate independent random data-encryption keys for new immutable document versions using reviewed authenticated encryption.
features.control: Secure randomness, unique nonces, authenticated context and version binding are mandatory.
features.acceptance: Tampering with nonce, ciphertext or document identity yields authentication failure.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Encrypt zero-knowledge documents before upload and decrypt only inside trusted client after independent authorization and key checks.
features.control: WordPress and ordinary document API never receive unwrapped keys or plaintext.
features.acceptance: Database, object storage and WordPress compromise yields no readable protected document.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Encrypt objects with per-version DEKs wrapped by tenant-scoped KMS/HSM-protected KEKs and tightly constrained service permissions.
features.control: KMS authority is inaccessible to WordPress runtime; managed-service compromise still carries plaintext risk.
features.acceptance: Copying only object store and database cannot decrypt content without external key service.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Assign tenant-specific or risk-based isolated key domains and independently managed grants, with disaster recovery design.
features.control: Subsidiary keys cannot unwrap any other subsidiary's records.
features.acceptance: Cross-tenant key substitution fails even with valid encrypted blobs.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Encrypt each zero-knowledge document DEK to approved user/device/group keys using a reviewed recipient-encryption protocol.
features.control: Server cannot forge a new recipient without verifiable client-authorized key distribution.
features.acceptance: Uninvited account with stolen server session cannot derive file key.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Provide verified device identities, recipient key history and mechanisms to detect unauthorized recipient-key changes.
features.control: Trust-on-first-use limitations are documented; use signed directories and out-of-band verification for high-risk groups.
features.acceptance: Unexpected public-key replacement requires validation and alerts affected users.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Use explicit consent and rewrapping to additional recipient keys without copying unrestricted plaintext through WordPress.
features.control: Both tenant policies and document ACL must allow disclosure.
features.acceptance: Shared protected document opens for named external tenant recipients only.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Rotate root/wrapping keys and re-encrypt or rewrap affected DEKs with documented impact and progress.
features.control: Rotation alone cannot revoke keys already copied to a device; high-risk revocation may demand re-encryption.
features.acceptance: Simulated compromised key triggers controlled rewrap and produces a verification report.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Revoke future retrieval and new key distribution, and optionally re-encrypt future and stored versions when confidentiality demands.
features.control: Cannot erase previously downloaded plaintext or keys; UI and policy explicitly disclose the limitation.
features.acceptance: Removed member cannot open newly rekeyed versions with an old key.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Offer opt-in enterprise recovery using predesignated trustees and threshold/quorum procedures, plus a strict no-recovery option.
features.control: Recovery is not 'zero-access to everyone' if escrow or trustee recovery exists; disclose that trade-off.
features.acceptance: Approved trustee quorum restores a lost user in test while minority of trustees cannot.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Track key ownership, origin, algorithm, version, creation, expiry, use, rotation, recovery and destruction without exposing secrets.
features.control: Key material never appears in logs, support bundles or routine databases.
features.acceptance: Auditor can trace key version used for a document without seeing private key bytes.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Protect sensitive names, descriptions, custom fields, comments, OCR outputs, search queries and derived previews with classified encryption.
features.control: Cleartext indexes contain only fields approved as leakage-safe, with explicit privacy review.
features.acceptance: Database export does not reveal protected document title or other marked metadata.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Protect sensitive audit payloads while preserving independent integrity, traceability and authorized detection.
features.control: Auditors have scoped decryption access separate from document access; SIEM exports minimize PII.
features.acceptance: A leaked log repository cannot reveal protected document plaintext or secrets.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Record crypto suite version and support rolling algorithm upgrades and decrypt/re-encrypt migration jobs.
features.control: Never invent custom cryptographic algorithms; use reviewed libraries and migration tests.
features.acceptance: Legacy suite test data is upgraded without losing integrity or version chain.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Define memory lifetime, temp file controls, no server plaintext dumps for zero-knowledge and strict worker isolation.
features.control: Managed processing deletes ephemeral plaintext on job completion and prevents debug logging of secrets.
features.acceptance: Crash tests find no persistent unencrypted extracted files in forbidden locations.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Destroy eligible wrapping keys or data keys after verifying that holds, backup policy and other copies permit erasure.
features.control: Crypto-erasure claims reflect residual copies, exported files and recovery keys.
features.acceptance: Disposition report documents key destruction evidence and known remaining exceptions.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.feature: Independent crypto review and test vectors
features.requirement: Require third-party cryptographic protocol review, interoperability vectors, cross-client validation and release-blocking security tests.
features.control: A successful feature demo is not evidence of cryptographic safety.
features.acceptance: Independent reviewers can reproduce encryption, rewrap, recovery and tamper test vectors.

features.module: Cryptography, zero-knowledge mode and key management
features.requirement: Define how offline clients, unavailable HSMs and key-service partitions affect read/write operations per mode.
features.control: Never fail open or silently cache root keys in WordPress to survive outages.
features.acceptance: Key-service outage blocks protected operations while preserving data integrity and clear status.

modules.title: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
modules.blurb: Defense-in-depth complements encryption with prevention, detection, containment and incident response.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Configure Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted and customizable sensitivity levels, categories and automatic labels.
features.control: More restrictive labels dominate inherited permissions and govern processing choices.
features.acceptance: Reclassifying to Restricted revokes prohibited sharing and exports promptly.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Detect approved sensitive patterns in managed-mode content, filenames, metadata and outbound actions.
features.control: No service plaintext inspection of zero-knowledge content; trusted client scanning is explicit and limited.
features.acceptance: Export of classified sample matching rule is blocked with policy reason.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Constrain download, printing, copy/paste and screenshots where supported by trusted clients.
features.control: Browser screenshot prevention is not guaranteed; claims clearly state deterrence limits.
features.acceptance: Restricted-mode policy denies available download and print commands across API/client.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Scan managed-mode uploads before release using isolated scanners; for zero-knowledge use client-side scanning and risk-restricted ingestion policy.
features.control: Servers cannot reliably scan opaque ciphertext; avoid claiming equivalent scanning assurance.
features.acceptance: Detected test malware is quarantined and never published into accessible repository.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Use sandboxed, patched, ephemeral converters with no internet egress to preview Office and PDF formats.
features.control: File parsing is high-risk and never runs inside WordPress PHP process.
features.acceptance: Malicious parser test does not reach storage, keys or production network.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Alert on abnormal mass downloads, suspicious access patterns, permission spikes and credential misuse.
features.control: Alerts minimize false accusations and give reviewers evidence and appeal process.
features.acceptance: Simulated mass export triggers scoped alert and optional containment.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Identify unusually high content churn, suspicious mass deletion and encryption-like rewrite patterns.
features.control: Immutable versions and protected backups are outside compromised service write authority.
features.acceptance: Mass corruption can be rolled back using clean version history after containment.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Govern permitted domains, classifications, link lifetimes, guest download and approved recipients.
features.control: No anonymous external links for high-security or zero-knowledge content by default.
features.acceptance: Attempt to externally share Restricted file without approval fails.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Apply visual classification banners and authorized identity watermarks in previews, printouts and selected exports.
features.control: Watermarks are not presented as prevention against photography or screen capture.
features.acceptance: Watermark reflects correct user/time/classification for approved export.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Restrict sensitive operations by approved networks, device signals and dynamic IP reputation.
features.control: Network restriction augments but never replaces cryptographic identity and authorization.
features.acceptance: Admin portal access from blocked network is denied and logged.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Enforce upload quotas, content sanitization, output escaping, CSRF defenses, CSP, SSRF prevention and safe parsers.
features.control: Test every admin, user, mobile and integration interface against injection and broken authorization.
features.acceptance: Automated vulnerability tests pass release security gate.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Generate SBOM, pin reviewed dependencies, sign releases, verify packages and rapidly patch vulnerabilities.
features.control: Compromised third-party WordPress plugins cannot be treated as trustworthy KMS components.
features.acceptance: Release signature and dependency provenance are verifiable in deployment pipeline.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Route prioritized events to security teams, support playbooks, acknowledgments and incident cases with breach clocks.
features.control: Events are protected against deletion by local WordPress administrators.
features.acceptance: Detection-to-triage trail can be reconstructed from independent evidence.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Show MFA compliance, privileged membership, guest exposure, encryption mode, overdue reviews and policy exceptions.
features.control: Subsidiary managers see own data; holding sees permitted aggregate posture.
features.acceptance: Audit dashboard highlights noncompliant tenant without exposing protected documents.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Rate-limit list, metadata, existence, autocomplete and search endpoints; apply stable-denial responses for hidden objects.
features.control: No metadata or timing oracle should trivially reveal confidential files.
features.acceptance: Enumeration tests fail to distinguish undisclosed document IDs within defined bounds.

features.module: Security operations, DLP and active threat defense
features.requirement: Publish security contact, responsible disclosure path, coordinated advisories and supported version policy.
features.control: No production secrets or customer documents are needed for disclosure intake.
features.acceptance: Security issue follows tracked triage, remediation, customer advisory and regression test.

modules.title: External collaboration and secure information exchange
modules.blurb: External exchange must balance business needs with recipient verification, encryption boundaries and revocation transparency.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Invite named external participants to documents or workspaces with verified email or federated identity.
features.control: Guests never receive automatic tenant-wide listing or browsing.
features.acceptance: New guest can access only the specifically invited material.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Issue opaque, bound and short-lived links with optional one-time use, download restrictions and independent recipient authentication.
features.control: Link possession alone is not sufficient for sensitive content; tokens cannot bypass permission checks.
features.acceptance: Expired, revoked and reused one-time link are denied.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Create segregated virtual due-diligence rooms with staged disclosure, access audit, Q&A and watermarked document previews.
features.control: Data room members are scoped individually and classified content may require zero-knowledge client.
features.acceptance: Two bidders see distinct curated document sets and never each other's questions.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: When sharing zero-knowledge documents, wrap keys for verified recipient device identities without routing plaintext through WP.
features.control: New recipient verification prevents a compromised server from silently swapping keys.
features.acceptance: Guest decrypts only explicitly shared version after trustworthy identity check.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
