features.requirement: Provide approved upload-only dropboxes for outside partners, vendors, auditors and customers.
features.control: Incoming files are quarantined, owner-routed and invisible to other senders.
features.acceptance: External party uploads but cannot list previously submitted files.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Configure guest membership termination, reminder and ownership-based renewals at project or transaction close.
features.control: Expiry revokes future access but not copies already downloaded.
features.acceptance: Guest loses access after expiry across all clients and tokens.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Create export bundles with manifests, recipients, justification, expiry and optional passwordless authentication.
features.control: Packaging checks every member document, legal hold and export approval.
features.acceptance: Package excludes a file whose rights were revoked during bundling.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Record approved purposes, sharing sponsor, allowed classifications and authorized recipients for intercompany exchanges.
features.control: No automatic blanket grants simply because companies share an owner.
features.acceptance: Cross-company data grant cannot proceed without required originating tenant approval.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Allow counterparties to comment on drafts and upload revisions within an isolated deal space.
features.control: Final approval remains under internal controls and external reviewers cannot edit released originals.
features.acceptance: Negotiation creates separate draft versions and final handoff evidence.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Publish specifically approved low-sensitivity articles into a searchable public knowledge base with explicit declassification workflow.
features.control: Public site runs on separate content publication path; never queries confidential repository as anonymous user.
features.acceptance: Approved article appears publicly; classified attachment remains unreachable.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Send notices with safe summaries, deep links and configurable confidential-data suppression.
features.control: No attachment of high-security plaintext content to ordinary email unless explicitly permitted.
features.acceptance: Invitation email contains no private filenames when classification forbids it.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Capture contractual acknowledgments, non-disclosure terms, access histories and partner offboarding.
features.control: Documents remain under source tenant governance and legal holds.
features.acceptance: External auditor report shows only permitted access events for named collaboration.

features.module: External collaboration and secure information exchange
features.requirement: Prompt periodic review of active intercompany spaces, expired projects, external permissions and recipient keys.
features.control: Review must consider cached keys and historic downloaded copies.
features.acceptance: Closing project revokes access, closes shares and launches configured rekey jobs.

modules.title: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
modules.blurb: Every meaningful decision and data access needs reviewable evidence, while aggregate reporting must not create a metadata side channel.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Record login, access decision, preview, export, key action, change, approval, hold, disposition and privileged elevation.
features.control: Collect and integrity-protect events outside WordPress administrator control.
features.acceptance: Local WordPress root compromise cannot silently edit historic audit entries.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Capture actor, verified tenant, resource, action, policy version, outcome, timestamp and request correlation.
features.control: Sensitive request bodies, plaintext secrets and document names may need redaction or encryption.
features.acceptance: Investigator reconstructs denied download and applicable ACL/policy rule.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Log view, download, offline sync and print attempts with success/failure and contextual risk information.
features.control: Log existence does not imply document contents were read; communicate event semantics accurately.
features.acceptance: Access report distinguishes link clicked, bytes streamed and explicit download completed.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Hash-chain or sign batches and anchor checkpoints to independently controlled storage or a trusted timestamp service.
features.control: Integrity proof must remain verifiable after key rotation and log archival.
features.acceptance: Modified middle event causes proof verification failure.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Show document counts, storage, approvals, expiring policies, overdue reviews, guest memberships and audit exception counts.
features.control: Drilldowns enforce same rights as primary content services.
features.acceptance: Tenant administrator sees their own entity's metrics and permitted breakdowns.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Display authorized group-level compliance posture, policy exceptions, workload trends and tenant operational health.
features.control: Holding reports provide aggregate counts without implied subsidiary plaintext read.
features.acceptance: Global administrator views summary while forbidden document links are absent.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Let authorized analysts choose columns, filters, schedules, aggregation and output type from a governed semantic layer.
features.control: Suppress or threshold small sensitive groups and apply row-level authorization.
features.acceptance: Report saved by entity A cannot access entity B via modified filter.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Generate periodic PDF/CSV/Excel summaries with secure delivery or protected portal links.
features.control: Report execution rechecks permissions at run time, not merely schedule creation.
features.acceptance: Revoking report owner's access stops future sensitive distributions.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Stream approved normalized audit events to SIEM through signed, resilient, structured integration with retries.
features.control: Confidential payloads are minimized, encryptable and tenant-separated.
features.acceptance: Event pipeline resumes from checkpoint without duplicate semantic incidents.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Provide the organization with traceable reports of who accessed or processed protected personal data.
features.control: Such reports have independent approvals and avoid exposing private document content.
features.acceptance: Data subject investigation report can identify relevant lawful handling events.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Measure average approval duration, first-pass acceptance, overdue items, bottleneck steps and policy renewal performance.
features.control: Avoid ranking individual employees by secret surveillance metrics.
features.acceptance: Dashboard figures reconcile to workflow ledger records.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Analyze search success, unanswered questions, stale guidance and usage trends using privacy-safe aggregation.
features.control: Query logs and click histories have retention, suppression and access controls.
features.acceptance: Search effectiveness report omits low-volume sensitive terms.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Export policy settings, role assignments, certifications, change records, key-control attestations and test evidence by period.
features.control: Evidence packages require scoped authorization and omit unreleasable content.
features.acceptance: External auditor validates digest and evidence manifest without admin database access.

features.module: Audit trails, reporting, analytics and oversight
features.requirement: Provide case-specific behavior timelines, change heat maps, download bursts and suspected account compromise trends.
features.control: AI/heuristics are advisory signals, not definitive guilt findings.
features.acceptance: Security analyst can replay anomaly timeline from signed events.

modules.title: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
modules.blurb: AI is optional and must honor both authorization and encryption boundaries; it is not a justification to weaken protected document handling.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Enable or prohibit AI by tenant, data classification, user role, model destination and document processing mode.
features.control: Explicitly block external processing of zero-knowledge plaintext absent approved client-controlled release.
features.acceptance: AI call for an excluded Restricted document is rejected before data leaves tenant boundary.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Answer questions using approved current documents with citations, source versions and permission-scoped retrieval.
features.control: Recheck source rights at retrieval and response; model text cannot grant file permissions.
features.acceptance: Same query yields no excerpts or citations from denied documents.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Generate summaries, executive briefs, action lists and change digests for authorized content.
features.control: Managed mode uses approved processing enclave; zero-knowledge summary runs locally or only after explicit disclosure.
features.acceptance: Summary links to source locations and is labeled as machine-generated.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Support embedding-based similarity and hybrid retrieval for permitted managed-mode collections.
features.control: Embeddings can leak data; encrypt/protect indexes and partition by tenant, class and rights.
features.acceptance: User cannot infer restricted phrases or vectors via nearest-neighbor queries.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Suggest category, sensitivity, owner, taxonomy and retention class using approved models.
features.control: Suggestion never downgrades restricted classification without human authorization.
features.acceptance: Human can accept/reject suggestion and reason is recorded.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Extract dates, counterparties, monetary terms, obligations, deliverables and renewal clauses from managed contracts.
features.control: Results have confidence, source evidence, user review and confidentiality controls.
features.acceptance: Extracted renewal date is traceable to clause and needs approval before workflow trigger.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Offer secure machine translation of permitted content in chosen language pairs with human-review workflow.
features.control: External vendors cannot receive protected text without approved data transfer and processing agreement.
features.acceptance: Translation preserves source references and reports unsupported formats honestly.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Suggest FAQ answers, summaries, procedures and outlines from permitted sources without publishing automatically.
features.control: Generated content is visibly AI-authored until human validation.
features.acceptance: Editor can reject draft and output never appears as certified policy by default.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Identify inconsistent policies, redundant guides and superseded instructions among authorized corpora.
features.control: Comparisons are scoped to parties allowed to inspect both sources.
features.acceptance: Conflict report cites exact authorized paragraphs and explains uncertainty.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Ask scoped questions about a file and receive cited responses with precise version and page references.
features.control: Zero-knowledge answering needs trusted local inference or explicit processing consent; do not silently upload keys.
features.acceptance: Each response either cites authorized source lines or declines when insufficient evidence.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Version system prompts, retrieval settings, model approvals, evaluations, cost controls and deployment regions.
features.control: System instructions and connectors are privileged, change-controlled configuration.
features.acceptance: AI run can be tied to reproducible model and prompt versions.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Treat retrieved documents, websites and OCR text as untrusted instructions; isolate tools from model-generated commands.
features.control: Model cannot read more documents or export information merely because source text requests it.
features.acceptance: Embedded instruction in a file fails to trigger unauthorized API access or exfiltration.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Log permitted metadata for queries, source IDs, model choices, consent, output handling and transfer records.
features.control: Minimize or encrypt prompt/response payloads; allow legitimate legal audit with proper access.
features.acceptance: Audit can show which approved sources supported an AI draft without exposing contents to holding admins.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Require named human approval for AI-triggered file changes, permission actions, policy publication and retention decisions.
features.control: Autonomous agent cannot modify security policy or dispose of records alone.
features.acceptance: An AI suggestion cannot execute privileged action until valid human approval.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Offer owner-approved removal of sensitive fields before model processing, with a local preview and provenance record.
features.control: Redaction must remove actual tokens, hidden content and derived metadata.
features.acceptance: AI outbound payload matches approved sanitized preview exactly.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Support enterprise settings for provider retention, regional processing, contractual no-training protections and private/on-prem model options.
features.control: Claims depend on verified provider contracts and telemetry, not a UI checkbox.
features.acceptance: Tenant can export evidence of approved model provider settings and transfers.

features.module: Privacy-aware AI, intelligence and automation
features.requirement: Measure grounding, hallucination, privacy leak, language performance and unsafe action rates against curated reference tests.
features.control: Release gates block model changes that regress critical authorization or privacy tests.
features.acceptance: Evaluator demonstrates benchmark results and regression history across 13 locales.

modules.title: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
modules.blurb: All 13 requested languages must be available for the interface and lifecycle communications; localization is different from translating private document bodies.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Ship English, Persian, French, Turkish, Russian, Chinese, German, Portuguese, Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, Arabic and Armenian.
features.control: No core workflow, error, permission dialog or critical legal notice may fall back silently without recorded translation coverage.
features.acceptance: Native-language reviewers complete onboarding, upload, approval and recovery flows in all 13 languages.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Define en, fa, fr, tr, ru, zh-Hans, de, pt, es, hi, ja, ar and hy baseline locales; design variants such as zh-Hant, pt-BR, es-MX separately.
features.control: Translation pack identity, fallback and legal terminology remain versioned.
features.acceptance: Locale switching persists and selected variant appears correctly across UI and emails.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Implement full RTL navigation, forms, dialogs, tables, breadcrumbs and icon mirroring where semantically appropriate.
features.control: Keep file hashes, emails, URLs, codes and numeric identifiers left-to-right within RTL text.
features.acceptance: Persian user completes long document approval on mobile without bidirectional text corruption.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Apply correct Arabic shaping, bidirectional controls and accessible date/number rendering.
features.control: Do not mirror logos, mathematical operators or content that should retain original direction.
features.acceptance: Arabic audit report and permissions matrix remain readable and aligned.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Support Unicode normalization and safe preservation of filenames in Armenian, Cyrillic, Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese and Arabic scripts.
features.control: Reject malicious bidi controls or visually confusable identifiers according to security policy.
features.acceptance: Upload and retrieve filenames in each script with preserved visible meaning.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Localize invitations, reminders, approval notices, error messages, alerts and recovery instructions per user choice.
features.control: Sensitive templates include approved legal/compliance wording and no plaintext secret leakage.
features.acceptance: User receives consistent language email, app notification and task names.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Render dates, times, numbers, currency, separators and local holidays according to locale and entity policy.
features.control: Store canonical UTC timestamps and machine-readable ISO dates; do not conflate Persian interface with specific legal calendar.
features.acceptance: Same event has equal UTC identity and correct localized display for two users.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Allow tenant admins to translate folder names, categories, custom field labels, workflows, taxonomy terms and help text.
features.control: Underlying identifiers stay language-neutral and permissions are independent of translation.
features.acceptance: Changing a field label in French does not break API filters or workflow conditions.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Link translations of knowledge pages and policies with different owners, approval states and effective dates.
features.control: A translated policy is not automatically certified when canonical source changes.
features.acceptance: Stale translation displays warning until reviewed and approved.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Validate mixed RTL/LTR text, hyperlinks, emails, numbers, audit IDs, password inputs and file paths.
features.control: Escape untrusted directional control chars and prevent spoofed file extensions.
features.acceptance: Bidirectional spoofing regression suite passes on browser and mobile.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Target WCAG 2.2 AA where applicable, with keyboard navigation, labels, visible focus, status feedback and accessible PDFs for exports where feasible.
features.control: Security controls including MFA and CAPTCHA remain usable with assistive technology.
features.acceptance: Core workflows pass manual accessibility review with screen readers.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Choose broadly available system font stacks and suitable web fonts with licensing and performance review for all scripts.
features.control: Never require downloading hidden font assets from untrusted CDN for a protected workflow.
features.acceptance: Every script remains legible on Windows, macOS, Android and iOS.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Maintain source string catalogs, context notes, translation review, terminology glossary, approval and regression snapshots.
features.control: Unapproved machine translations are not treated as legal-compliance translations.
features.acceptance: Release candidate reports 100% coverage for critical strings and tracked noncritical exceptions.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Support language-aware sorting, tokenization, transliteration where appropriate and correct casing including Turkish dotted/dotless I.
features.control: Search indexes must preserve tenant and authorization scopes across languages.
features.acceptance: Locale-specific query fixture suite yields correct permitted results.

features.module: Internationalization, languages and accessibility
features.requirement: Support templates, exported reports and optional PDFs with correct RTL layout, text shaping and mixed-direction values.
features.control: Confidential exports follow mode-specific processing and watermark policies.
features.acceptance: Exported report renders correctly in Persian, Arabic, Armenian and Chinese sample sets.

modules.title: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
modules.blurb: Expose a stable, least-privilege integration surface independent of the WordPress UI and with rigorous versioning and tenant limits.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Publish documented operations for identities, tenants, folders, files, versions, metadata, permissions, workflows and reporting.
features.control: Each endpoint independently authenticates tenant-scoped principals and enforces operation-level authorization.
features.acceptance: OpenAPI contract tests reject malicious cross-tenant IDs across all endpoints.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Issue signed event webhooks for lifecycle, approval, user and governance changes with configurable recipient filters.
features.control: Retry delivery safely and never send unapproved sensitive metadata.
features.acceptance: Subscriber verifies signature and handles duplicated event delivery idempotently.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Support federated enterprise authentication and identity mapping with multiple IdPs where justified.
features.control: Validate protocol messages and tenant trust separately from WordPress authentication.
features.acceptance: Authentication via a subsidiary IdP does not grant membership in another subsidiary.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Synchronize users, groups, membership suspension and role assignment from enterprise identity directories.
features.control: Prevent inbound attribute mappings from creating group super-administrator rights.
features.acceptance: Create, suspend and remove user scenario reconciles without orphan access.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Integrate permitted Office editing, Outlook document capture, Teams links and SharePoint import/export.
features.control: External editors may be restricted to managed mode; disclose exposure to provider services.
features.acceptance: Integrated session maintains correct tenant and version lineage.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Integrate approved Drive import/export, Google identity and optional browser editing for managed documents.
features.control: No automatic copying of zero-knowledge plaintext to outside platforms.
features.acceptance: Admin can connect and disconnect integration with complete token revocation.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Provide connectors or SDK patterns for SAP, Dynamics, Salesforce, Odoo, ERP, HRIS and procurement platforms.
features.control: Each connector obtains narrow business-object and document permissions.
features.acceptance: A contract linked to approved ERP record has consistent referential and audit history.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Send safe links and workflow notifications to Teams, Slack or similar services with recipient mapping.
features.control: No restricted plaintext in chat messages without configured policy.
features.acceptance: Message recipient cannot use shared link without actual document rights.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Abstract content editors and converters behind evaluated, replaceable connectors with availability and trust checks.
features.control: E2EE content requires trusted compatible editor or explicit secure processing consent.
features.acceptance: Removing a third-party editor does not destroy stored document versions.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Support approved S3-compatible object stores and, optionally, sovereign/on-prem storage backends.
features.control: Adapter cannot return an unverified raw public object URL.
features.acceptance: Object storage swap preserves isolation, integrity and retention semantics.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Optionally expose permission-trimmed metadata to approved internal search services with revocation propagation.
features.control: Protected full-text or embeddings cannot be mirrored without mode-compatible processing.
features.acceptance: External search user loses results promptly after rights revocation.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Publish bounded lifecycle events through tenant-aware queues with schema registry, dead-letter and replay support.
features.control: Workload identities and tenant context are checked at each consumer hop.
features.acceptance: Poisoned event is quarantined rather than retried forever.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Support JSON/CSV metadata, document packages, signed manifests, and open interoperability mappings such as CMIS where practical.
features.control: Export policy checks must occur before object or metadata serialization.
features.acceptance: Contract-test import/export preserves document version IDs and provenance.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Maintain centrally approved connectors with per-tenant enablement, permissions, owner and security posture.
features.control: Connector cannot gain access by installation alone; elevated scopes require approvals.
features.acceptance: Disabling connector revokes access and suspends queued jobs.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Rate-limit by client, tenant, action, token and sensitivity, with usage dashboards and quotas.
features.control: Throttling must not leak existence of other tenants' workloads.
features.acceptance: Stress test confirms fair tenant isolation under 10x baseline workload.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Provide separate nonproduction test tenants, sample data, test webhooks and deterministic API fixtures.
features.control: Sandbox credentials and objects never reach production key domains.
features.acceptance: Integration can be validated end-to-end without production user documents.

features.module: Integrations, APIs, automation and interoperability
features.requirement: Use the plugin for navigational integration, approved settings and deep links to the secure service, not for passing plaintext secrets.
features.control: No WordPress role, nonce or session alone authorizes repository access; no broad KMS grants to PHP.
features.acceptance: Attack simulation with WordPress admin privileges cannot call protected decrypt endpoints.

modules.title: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
modules.blurb: The product must be understandable to nontechnical users while making sensitive context, effective permissions and document status obvious.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Provide distinct home views for holding operator, entity admin, contributor, reviewer, legal custodian and auditor.
features.control: Tiles reflect real entitlements, not visibility-only frontend filters.
features.acceptance: A user role switch changes dashboard without altering backend rights.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Customize each subsidiary logo, approved color palette, terminology, homepage and help contacts.
features.control: Brand configuration cannot inject scripts or defeat accessible contrast.
features.acceptance: Two subsidiaries display distinct safe identities from one deployment.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Support breadcrumbs, hierarchy tree, previews, filters, sorting, favorites, quick actions and keyboard interactions.
features.control: Directory listing excludes unauthorized files, counts and hidden folder suggestions.
features.acceptance: Explorer works on mobile and keyboard without accidental cross-tenant context.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Show approvals, access requests, policy attestations, mentions, subscriptions and security notices.
features.control: Notification details undergo rights checks both when created and when viewed.
features.acceptance: Revoked document generates only safe stale-notification placeholder.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Let admins arrange approved widgets, KPIs, announcements and smart collections by role or department.
features.control: Widget definitions cannot bypass the governed reporting layer.
features.acceptance: Unauthorized user does not see metadata via a custom widget.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Provide accessible filtering, column configuration, multi-select and permitted batch operations with dry-run summaries.
features.control: Every item in batch has its own authorization and retention evaluation.
features.acceptance: Batch action reports partial failures without modifying blocked records.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Show owners and users why a document is visible, restricted, downloadable or subject to a hold, at an appropriate disclosure level.
features.control: Denial messages must not reveal hidden document existence or another user's attributes.
features.acceptance: Access manager can diagnose effective rights from same rule engine as API.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Provide shortcut search across permitted pages, documents, people, actions and workflow tasks.
features.control: Autocomplete trims private suggestions before rendering.
features.acceptance: Command palette never displays another tenant's projects.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Allow per-user digest frequency, channels, quiet hours, locale and security-alert exceptions.
features.control: Mandatory incident/security notices cannot be silently disabled where policy requires.
features.acceptance: User opts out of weekly digest while still receiving critical account alert.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Provide localized first-run tours, help center, tooltips and troubleshooting linked to exact feature permissions.
features.control: Help examples use synthetic data and never log secret inputs.
features.acceptance: New admin can complete 10-tenant setup guide using localized content.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Let users save filters, favorite documents, custom boards and secure links to recurring tasks.
features.control: Saved layouts never serve previously accessible confidential data from stale cache.
features.acceptance: After revocation, favorites remain hidden or restricted without title leakage.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Support multi-key shortcuts, rapid assignment, drag-and-drop and controlled actions for expert users.
features.control: Shortcut activations always invoke same authorization validation as visible buttons.
features.acceptance: User cannot trigger restricted action via keyboard path.

features.module: Experience, productivity and configurable workspaces
features.requirement: Provide actionable recovery messages for key mismatch, upload interruption, policy conflict, expired links and offline states.
features.control: Error details are sanitized and never expose database, key service or secret information.
features.acceptance: Errors link to appropriate remediation without disclosing confidential identifiers.

modules.title: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
modules.blurb: Sensitive content use on endpoints needs client-native protections, documented offline behavior and isolation from compromised WordPress delivery paths.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Offer usable reading, search, uploads, approvals and knowledge browsing on modern mobile browsers.
features.control: Sensitive cryptography uses independently trusted document client where required.
features.acceptance: Core scenario suite passes iOS Safari and Android Chrome.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Provide signed desktop application with secure storage, zero-knowledge key handling and optional filesystem integration.
features.control: Update mechanism verifies signatures and origin; no plugin-delivered executable replacement without validation.
features.acceptance: Tampered installer/update is rejected and event recorded.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Provide iOS and Android apps with OS keystore use, biometrics as local unlock and enterprise device-management hooks.
features.control: Biometric unlock supplements valid identity and token policy; keys remain protected by device platform.
features.acceptance: Device loss revokes refresh tokens and prevents subsequent sync.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Allow policy-selected local encrypted copies, expiry and reauthentication windows with user-readable storage indicator.
features.control: Offline right cannot be retroactively withdrawn from copied plaintext, so use classification restrictions.
features.acceptance: Offline document remains encrypted at rest and inaccessible beyond configured client unlock policy.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Sync only approved folders/documents selected by user or admin, with conflict rules and bandwidth controls.
features.control: Rights must be reevaluated at online sync and rejected files purged as possible.
features.acceptance: Deactivated user cannot obtain new material after reconnect.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Permit device-session revocation, selective cache wipe on reconnect and lost-device recovery workflows.
features.control: Remote wipe is best effort and cannot erase unmanaged offline copies with certainty.
features.acceptance: Revoked client removes eligible cached content once device reconnects.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Support camera scanning, crop, rotation, multi-page merge and secure upload from approved device.
features.control: Image EXIF/geolocation stripping and client-side encryption obey tenant policy.
features.acceptance: Captured confidential scan uploads encrypted without appearing in public photo gallery.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Send safe actionable notices for tasks and approvals without leaking content to push provider payloads.
features.control: No private document titles in lock-screen pushes for restrictive classes.
features.acceptance: Notification can open the app only after session revalidation.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Add optional safe drag-and-drop from Office, open/save integration and contextual upload with classification prompts.
features.control: External file handlers are explicitly evaluated against zero-knowledge policy.
features.acceptance: Edited file imports as new version rather than silently overwriting master.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Manage endpoint trust enrollment, key fingerprints and compromised-device recovery for zero-knowledge clients.
features.control: Malicious server cannot authorize an undetected new recipient device under strict policy.
features.acceptance: Unauthorized device enrollment alerts owner and does not receive past keys.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Support pagination, progressive thumbnails, resumable transfer and constrained mobile usage.
features.control: Reduced bandwidth cannot skip verification, malware policies or encryption checks.
features.acceptance: Representative 3G profile can navigate and resume encrypted transfers.

features.module: Mobile, desktop, offline and endpoint experience
features.requirement: Validate screen readers, 13 languages, dynamic font sizes, Arabic/Persian RTL and touch targets on mobile.
features.control: Security dialogs must remain accessible and legible with large text.
features.acceptance: All required workflows pass mobile localization and accessibility checklists.

modules.title: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
modules.blurb: Compliance is a continuing organizational process. The software should provide controls and evidence but cannot itself certify that every deployment complies with every law.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Minimize personal data collected and default to restricted visibility, limited retention and no unapproved public sharing.
features.control: Privacy impact review is mandatory for new analytics, AI and connector features.
features.acceptance: New subsidiary starts without unnecessary profile fields or default public access.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Track data categories, legal purposes, controllers/processors, recipients, processing locations and associated systems per subsidiary.
features.control: Internal privacy inventories require access controls and audit.
features.acceptance: Privacy officer exports current processing record with responsible parties.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Maintain configurable controls for applicable jurisdictions, industries and document categories with legal-owner signoff.
features.control: Do not claim universal GDPR/HIPAA/ISO compliance solely from enabling presets.
features.acceptance: Tenant applies an approved profile and receives exceptions requiring legal review.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Manage privacy requests for access, correction, restriction, portability and erasure with accountable workflows and deadlines.
features.control: Identity verification and third-party redaction are required before release.
features.acceptance: Request package contains lawful information while masking other individuals' records.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Minimize identifiers, aggregate where feasible and retain behavioral logs no longer than approved purposes.
features.control: Suppress small groups and offer documented lawful basis and opt-outs where applicable.
features.acceptance: Analytics export does not expose identifiable private behavior beyond approved role.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Record relevant notices, appropriate consent or other lawful basis, versions and withdrawal handling where required.
features.control: Avoid treating consent as legal basis for employee data by default.
features.acceptance: Notice history is tied to user and tenant with effective dates.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Produce inventory of object, database, backup, search, logs and AI transfer locations against each subsidiary's policy.
features.control: Unapproved transfers block workflow and raise alert, including failover and vendor telemetry.
features.acceptance: Data-location report detects test misconfigured backup region.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Record approved processors, risk assessments, data-processing agreements, vendor categories and expiry.
features.control: Tokenized integrations cannot access content until tenant approves destination and purpose.
features.acceptance: Disabling approved vendor blocks new outbound processing and invokes offboarding checklist.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Provide a transparent precedence engine for subject erasure, records retention, litigation hold and contractual obligations.
features.control: Legal exceptions require accountable review and case notes.
features.acceptance: Held record is preserved while eligible personal metadata is removed from other systems.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Maintain risk/impact assessments for new features, sensitive processing and automated decisions.
features.control: Assess threat model, retention, user impact and safeguards before launch.
features.acceptance: New AI provider cannot be enabled until an authorized assessment is approved.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Maintain accessibility conformance tracking, localization QA and accommodation request processes.
features.control: Critical security features must not exclude users who rely on assistive technology.
features.acceptance: Accessibility issues have severity, owner, reproducible test and release gate.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Log group-level privacy/security instructions and tenant decisions, including delegated modifications.
features.control: Holdings cannot issue invisible instructions that silently reduce tenant secrecy.
features.acceptance: Auditor reconstructs policy instruction version and consenting entity.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Provide reversible export of owned documents/metadata and clear deletion/decommission procedures for cloud or on-prem deployment.
features.control: Export respects each subsidiary's ownership, holds and cryptographic trust.
features.acceptance: Controlled exit drill migrates sample tenant without data loss or external user exposure.

features.module: Privacy, compliance, residency and lawful processing
features.requirement: Maintain contact trees, incident clocks, forensic evidence, breach assessment forms and regulator/customer notification workflows.
features.control: Legal obligation varies by jurisdiction and requires expert determination.
features.acceptance: Tabletop breach drill yields time-stamped decision and notification package.

modules.title: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
modules.blurb: High availability and quality are measurable engineering outcomes, not adjectives. Proposed targets must be confirmed through capacity planning, testing and service contracts.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Separate WordPress plugin, trusted clients, identity, API, authorization, encryption, storage and audit into bounded deployable components.
features.control: WordPress has no direct database superuser, root key, universal decrypted file endpoint or audit-delete right.
features.acceptance: WordPress full-compromise drill cannot read zero-knowledge ciphertext or alter independent audit history.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Use documented tenant IDs, tenant-enforced queries, migration framework and optional database/schema separation by risk tier.
features.control: Database row-level security and service-side checks are defense-in-depth, not substitutes.
features.acceptance: Automated attempts to alter tenant IDs fail across reads, writes and joins.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Store versioned, encrypted objects with verified consistency, checksums, lifecycle rules and policy-based immutability.
features.control: Object access credentials are least privilege and short lived; key separation is mandatory.
features.acceptance: Corrupted object produces alert and recoverable restoration path.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Set proposed monthly availability objective, e.g. 99.9% for core reads, with exclusions and monitored error budgets.
features.control: Mode-specific key service dependencies are included; do not claim guaranteed uptime without tests and contracts.
features.acceptance: SLO dashboard reconciles true error rate and outage events.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Set proposed RPO 15 minutes and RTO 4 hours for initial enterprise tier, subject to design and test.
features.control: Targets vary by storage tier, legal holds, key availability and offline client state.
features.acceptance: Disaster recovery exercise demonstrates measured recovery within agreed targets.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Backup metadata, encrypted objects, configurations, key recovery material and independent audit logs under separate credentials.
features.control: Backups cannot be deleted by compromised application accounts; recoverability is tested.
features.acceptance: Random restored backup yields correct versions and authorizations in isolated environment.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Maintain immutable backup copies and periodic protected offline recovery sets with distinct operators.
features.control: Backups also obey residency and expiration policy and protect escrow/trustees.
features.acceptance: Simulated ransomware fails to destroy recovery points.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Instrument service latency, error rate, queue depth, storage, key errors, indexing and tenant resource saturation.
features.control: Telemetry must not record document plaintext, credentials or private keys.
features.acceptance: An injected key-service fault raises correctly prioritized alert and status.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Correlate user action across UI, API, policy decision, storage, workflow and key operations with privacy-safe identifiers.
features.control: Trace tokens cannot be used as bearer credentials or expose tenant content.
features.acceptance: Investigators follow one request across services with common ID.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Deploy reproducibly with peer-reviewed infrastructure definitions, locked policies and automated drift alerts.
features.control: Production secrets are not stored in code repositories or artifact builds.
features.acceptance: Fresh deployment matches security baselines and detects out-of-band changes.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Run unit, integration, authorization, dependency, secret, static and dynamic security scans on every releasable build.
features.control: Critical findings block release until remediation or formally approved exception that does not defeat essential guarantees.
features.acceptance: Pipeline rejects intentionally inserted broken authorization case.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Commission independent tests of WordPress pivot, identity takeover, cross-tenant BOLA, crypto protocol, import parsers and recovery.
features.control: Findings are severity-ranked, tracked and retested; no blanket claim of flawlessness.
features.acceptance: Evidence shows high/critical findings remediated before production release.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Maintain attack trees for stolen backups, hostile WordPress, compromised identity, malicious insider, endpoint theft and vendor failure.
features.control: Each new zero-knowledge feature updates assumptions and residual risks.
features.acceptance: Architecture review maps each adversary to concrete blocking control and test.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Establish workload profile for 10 initial entities and future scaling, including document count, file size, concurrency and search latency.
features.control: Tests include adversarial uploads, tenant skew and key service outage.
features.acceptance: Load report shows capacity, saturation point and known limits for a benchmark dataset.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Version and sign plugin, client and service updates with canary rollout, backward compatibility and safe rollback.
features.control: Crypto format migrations are irreversible only after verified backup and recovery checks.
features.acceptance: Failed rollout reverts without losing committed documents or permissions.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Roll out advanced modules by tenant and role using scoped, versioned, auditable flags.
features.control: Flags cannot disable core authorization, encryption or audit controls.
features.acceptance: Turning off AI only disables AI, leaving document access unaffected.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Provide health-check bundles, redacted configuration, version data, anonymized logs and scoped diagnostics.
features.control: Support personnel cannot obtain customer plaintext or recovery keys via diagnostic function.
features.acceptance: Support bundle contains no sensitive markers from seeded secrets.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Document incidents, key loss, storage corruption, database restore, tenant closure, rotation and compromised endpoints with on-call responsibilities.
features.control: Runbooks include explicit stop conditions and authorization approval gates.
features.acceptance: Operator completes tabletop using runbook without undocumented privileged actions.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Scale workers and indexes horizontally; partition tenant storage/workloads without changing authorization invariants.
features.control: Queue fairness, rate limits and encryption boundary remain correct during migration.
features.acceptance: Doubling tenants with representative workload does not increase cross-tenant errors.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Restore selected documents, versions, metadata, ACLs or full tenant from signed encrypted backup manifests.
features.control: Restores cannot reinstate revoked access or accidentally unseal previously destroyed keys.
features.acceptance: Recover one deleted tenant collection under controlled approval while preserving current restrictions.

features.module: Reliability, deployment, operations and quality engineering
features.requirement: Document replacement of cloud vendors, secret revocation, data export, tenant relocation and system shutdown.
features.control: Vendor change does not weaken confidentiality or legal retention.
features.acceptance: Controlled continuity drill proves sample restore into alternate approved environment.

modules.title: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
modules.blurb: A superior platform must convert legacy knowledge into governed records and help subsidiaries manage change safely.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Guide creation of entities, corporate branding, administrators, teams, policies, storage regions and initial collections.
features.control: Enforce locked minimum encryption, MFA and sharing settings in the wizard.
features.acceptance: New tenant is configured through complete checklist without manual database changes.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Import folders/files from approved SMB, SFTP and exported archives with mapping of owners, paths and timestamps.
features.control: Source credentials are short-lived and scanning/retention policies apply to imported files.
features.acceptance: Import report accounts for every source file and failed import with retry reason.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Connect to approved cloud DMS exports/APIs and map historical versions, metadata, links and permissions.
features.control: Never assume foreign ACL maps directly to new protected system capabilities.
features.acceptance: Pilot import flags unmapped accounts and forbidden external shares before cutover.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Import approved wiki pages, attachments, hierarchies, links and revisions into secure knowledge spaces.
features.control: Private wiki spaces cannot be made public by importer defaults.
features.acceptance: Imported page references resolve or appear in a remediation queue.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Analyze source inventory, duplicate names, path limits, unsupported formats, classification gaps and user collisions without modifying live data.
features.control: Preview access limited to authorized project administrators.
features.acceptance: Dry-run provides complete issue list and projected quota use.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Map legacy users, departments, role groups and orphan accounts to explicit tenant memberships and custom roles.
features.control: Imported permissions fail closed until approved; no implicit admin mappings.
features.acceptance: Unmapped privileged source account cannot access target tenant.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Record source identifiers, hashes, size, destination IDs, timestamps, version relationships and reconciliation state.
features.control: Manifest is integrity protected and excludes unnecessary sensitive plaintext.
features.acceptance: Sampled files match signed origin mapping and all discrepancies are reported.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Start with one subsidiary, then wave deployments, training and success criteria across the 10 entities.
features.control: No subsidiary's security posture depends on unfinished migration of another.
features.acceptance: Pilot passes security and user acceptance before rollout to remaining entities.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Provide localized tutorials for administrators, contributors, legal staff, reviewers, mobile users and zero-knowledge recovery trustees.
features.control: Teach the difference between revocation and deletion of already downloaded copies.
features.acceptance: Role-based quiz confirms understanding of critical access and confidentiality workflows.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Flag duplicates, obsolete policies, stale ownership and inconsistent naming for governed remediation.
features.control: Machine-generated classifications must be reviewed for sensitive document types.
features.acceptance: Published legacy policy requires owner and review date before official designation.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Track help tickets, diagnostic requests, incident escalation and tenant administrators with role-aware customer support controls.
features.control: Support impersonation is off by default and cannot bypass protected-mode key access.
features.acceptance: Support case shows approvals, masked context and complete access history.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Publish deployment guides, admin/security handbooks, translations, privacy notes, SDK guides and user manuals with version tags.
features.control: Document all unsupported combinations and residual risks instead of hiding them.
features.acceptance: Release checklist verifies manuals for every changed critical feature.

features.module: Onboarding, migration, adoption and support
features.requirement: Supply sample synthetic documents, demo tenants, test roles and resettable workflow scenarios.
features.control: Sandbox is isolated from production identities, crypto keys and audit.
features.acceptance: Trainer resets sample company without affecting a real tenant.

modules.title: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
modules.blurb: Optional vertical modules increase breadth but must reuse the same secure repository, policy engine and information-governance framework.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Manage request, draft, review, clause library, negotiation, execution, obligations and renewal.
features.control: High-risk contract data remains classification-bound and signature provider disclosures are explicit.
features.acceptance: Agreement alert triggers before approved renewal deadline with linked version evidence.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Build encrypted board packs, agendas, minutes, resolutions, voting workflow and approved meeting archives.
features.control: Board confidentiality can mandate zero-knowledge mode and stricter device checks.
features.acceptance: Revoked board member cannot open new pack from expired session.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Manage formal policies, version approvals, distribution, acknowledgments, exceptions and supersession.
features.control: Only certified current versions appear in official policy navigation.
features.acceptance: Annual policy cycle produces review and attestation evidence.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Record nonconformities, corrective/preventive actions, evidence, inspections and controlled procedures.
features.control: Quality evidence is immutable or versioned according to record class.
features.acceptance: CAPA closure requires evidence review and authorized sign-off.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Track risks, obligations, controls, control owners, evidence and audits linked to relevant records.
features.control: Sensitive incident details remain limited to risk team and approved auditors.
features.acceptance: Control owner can trace risk mitigation to signed policy version.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Support transmittals, revision registers, drawing review, document submittals and external engineering parties.
features.control: Revision releases do not overwrite previous approved artifacts and vendor permissions expire.
features.acceptance: Project document register accurately reflects latest accepted revision.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Manage employee files, case-specific HR permissions, offboarding, retention and subject-access requests.
features.control: HR record visibility cannot be inferred from generic department membership.
features.acceptance: Department administrator without HR case rights cannot search employee files.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Combine vendor onboarding, compliance certificates, contracts, invoices and risk reviews in a controlled collection.
features.control: Third-party uploads enter isolated review and malware quarantine.
features.acceptance: Supplier cannot see another supplier's submissions.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Provide bidder-specific question workflows, invitation status and document access analytics for due diligence.
features.control: Aggregated analytics avoid revealing identity of other bidders or privileged material.
features.acceptance: Seller reviews each bidder's permitted activity only.

features.module: Specialized enterprise modules and future differentiation
features.requirement: Provide plugin extension points for legal, healthcare, construction, energy or public-sector workflows under security-reviewed contracts.
features.control: Extensions cannot bypass tenant ACL, keys, audit or retention engine.
features.acceptance: Example extension fails integration tests if it requests unauthorized direct storage access.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Model parent holding company, subsidiaries, divisions, departments, teams and optional project workspaces; support future nested groups without changing authorization semantics.
features.control: Relationships are scoped; no subsidiary inherits another subsidiary's members or data.
features.acceptance: Create a group with 10 subsidiaries and verify independent organizational trees and document inventories.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Create a subsidiary from a policy template, assign administrators, select storage residency, branding, default taxonomy and encryption mode.
features.control: Provisioning is idempotent and cannot reuse a retired tenant's identifiers or keys.
features.acceptance: A new subsidiary is operational with its own administrators and an empty private repository.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Suspend sign-in, editing, sharing and exports without automatically destroying retained records; close tenants only via approved disposition workflow.
features.control: Retention and legal holds override closure or deletion.
features.acceptance: Suspension denies access immediately while preserving compliant records and audit evidence.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Set configurable storage, API request, background job and user limits for each subsidiary and aggregate group budgets.
features.control: Per-tenant throttling prevents noisy neighbors from exhausting shared resources.
features.acceptance: Tenant A reaches its limit without degrading tenant B or compromising access rules.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Let each subsidiary administer its own users, groups, roles, categories, folders, workflows and settings within group policy bounds.
features.control: Group administrators cannot silently elevate content access or view encryption keys.
features.acceptance: A subsidiary admin changes its own settings without affecting another subsidiary.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: The holding company defines mandatory minimum policies such as MFA, encryption, retention floors and prohibited sharing modes.
features.control: Subsidiaries may strengthen but not weaken locked global controls.
features.acceptance: Attempts to relax a locked group control fail with a specific audit entry.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Create explicit cross-entity workspaces with named participating organizations, custodians, scope, expiry and document-specific entitlements.
features.control: Each participating tenant authorizes sharing; encrypted keys are distributed only to authorized recipients.
features.acceptance: A project member can open approved materials but no other participating subsidiary files.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: For a person with memberships in multiple entities, provide a clear active-tenant switcher and context indicators throughout the UI.
features.control: Server derives tenant context from verified membership, never from an untrusted request field alone.
features.acceptance: Changing the selected tenant cannot expose results or cached content from the previous tenant.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Separate files, cache objects, queue tasks, search indexes, logs and backup inventory using enforceable tenant scopes.
features.control: Direct object references and cache keys are checked for correct tenant binding.
features.acceptance: Automated tenant crossover tests cannot list, read, edit or export foreign objects.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Export authorized documents, versions, metadata, permissions, audit excerpts and signed manifests into a documented interchange format.
features.control: Export requires privileged approval and respects holds, encryption modes and privacy limits.
features.acceptance: Export can be validated and reimported into a clean deployment without loss of authorized metadata.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Record registered business name, legal identifiers, jurisdictions, retention owner, legal contacts and approved admin domains.
features.control: Sensitive identifiers are protected and changes to legal ownership require elevated approval.
features.acceptance: Change history and legal-entity version are retained for every tenant.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Give holding auditors permitted aggregate metrics across subsidiaries: count, usage, policy compliance, incident status and workflow bottlenecks.
features.control: Report totals do not disclose document titles or contents absent explicit authorization.
features.acceptance: Holding dashboard displays counts without permitting click-through into unauthorized content.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Allow each tenant to select approved geographic storage/processing regions and enforce placement for data, backups, search, AI and metadata.
features.control: Cross-region failover is disabled when it would violate residency rules.
features.acceptance: Data location audit proves configured locations and blocks unapproved region processing.

features.module: Holding-company structure and tenant isolation
features.requirement: Support subsidiary rename, merger, split, transfer or liquidation through an explicit migration and consent process.
features.control: No silent transfer of records, keys or rights; preservation schedules remain intact.
features.acceptance: Trial migration produces an impact report and reversible staging before cutover.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Represent a person once in the identity service and create independent active, suspended or expired memberships in any number of subsidiaries.
features.control: Memberships have tenant-specific roles, entitlements and expiry.
features.acceptance: Deactivating tenant A membership does not affect an approved membership in tenant B.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Allow admins to name roles, select granular capabilities and publish versioned role templates for their own subsidiary.
features.control: New roles default to no privileges; self-escalation is blocked.
features.acceptance: Create an HR Reviewer role and verify only selected operations are allowed.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Permit reusable role bundles but show the full effective permission set before assigning.
features.control: Privileges never imply cross-tenant access; privilege amplification via nested roles is rejected.
features.acceptance: Role editor identifies and blocks conflicting or unauthorized capability combinations.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Support directory-synced and locally managed teams, dynamic groups and project-specific memberships.
features.control: Dynamic membership rules are evaluated securely and require approval for privileged scopes.
features.acceptance: Removing a member from a group revokes future access and triggers key policy actions.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Grant view, comment, edit, manage, share, print, download, export and delete independently to users, groups and roles.
features.control: Explicit deny overrides grants, and absent permission means deny.
features.acceptance: A viewer permitted to preview but not download receives denial for every export endpoint.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Combine role grants with classification, owner, department, device posture, location, network and time conditions.
features.control: Context claims are trusted only from authenticated sources and reevaluated on sensitive operations.
features.acceptance: A confidential document cannot be opened outside permitted contextual conditions.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Allow inheritance from parent folders, with controlled exceptions and a visual explanation of effective rights.
features.control: Child restrictions may tighten defaults; conflicts resolve deterministically and fail closed.
features.acceptance: Moving a document between folders recalculates rights without exposing it mid-transaction.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Provide a who-can-access-what tester showing allow/deny decisions and the applicable rules without displaying protected content.
features.control: Only authorized admins can inspect policy traces and simulations are audited.
features.acceptance: Admin enters user, document and action and receives a reproducible decision trace.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Let users request access with a purpose and expiry; route to document owners and designated access approvers.
features.control: Requester cannot approve own request; high-sensitivity grants may require two independent approvers.
features.acceptance: An approved grant expires automatically and leaves a complete audit trail.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Support start/end dates, one-time grants and session-bound access for temporary projects and external specialists.
features.control: Expired grants are denied before file streaming or key distribution.
features.acceptance: Access immediately fails after expiry even when old links are reused.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Prevent conflicting combinations such as creator and final approver or custodian and unilateral disposition authorizer.
features.control: Conflicts are checked at assignment and at action time, including delegated permissions.
features.acceptance: Workflow fails closed when an actor attempts both conflicting steps.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Delegate limited user, folder or workflow administration for a date range without granting content read or key access.
features.control: Delegation scope is narrow, explicit, revocable and logged.
features.acceptance: Delegated manager can update permitted assignments but cannot view confidential files.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Provide highly restricted emergency access to managed-mode resources when explicitly allowed, with independent approval and incident ticket linkage.
features.control: Zero-Knowledge content has no magical break-glass; recovery requires its separate approved key-recovery design.
features.acceptance: Emergency grants are time-bound, alerted and reviewed afterward.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Issue machine identities for imports, scans, connectors and jobs with narrowly scoped operations and credentials.
features.control: No shared superuser tokens or unscoped background execution.
features.acceptance: Revoking a workload identity immediately disables its operations and produces audit events.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Report all privileged accounts, public/external grants, inherited policies, stale accounts and exceptions by subsidiary.
features.control: Queries redact private names/titles where reporting actor lacks rights.
features.acceptance: Quarterly entitlement review generates an actionable report with approvals.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Assign managers or custodians to recertify access to sensitive folders and users on defined schedules.
features.control: Unreviewed rights expire or enter restriction according to policy.
features.acceptance: Certification cycle tracks attestations, overdue reviews and revocations.

features.module: Identity, membership, roles and authorization
features.requirement: Recheck permissions when generating download grants, streaming files, applying versions and delivering queued content.
features.control: Revoked access wins over stale caches or background jobs.
features.acceptance: Revoke rights during a large download and verify the system blocks subsequent authorized fetches as designed.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Integrate OIDC and optionally SAML identity providers per tenant or central enterprise directory.
features.control: Validate audience, issuer, signature, expiration and tenant binding; reject insecure SSO fallbacks.
features.acceptance: Single sign-on creates only memberships explicitly mapped from trusted identity claims.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Support phishing-resistant passkeys or hardware-backed MFA for privileged and sensitive roles; provide secondary enrollment controls.
features.control: Enforce step-up MFA for exports, privileged changes and recovery.
features.acceptance: A privileged action without the required second factor is rejected.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Support explicitly approved local accounts where SSO is unavailable, with Argon2id password hashing and secure recovery.
features.control: No plaintext or reversible password storage; disable local fallback when tenant policy forbids it.
features.acceptance: Password resets invalidate prior sessions and trigger notification.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Provision and deprovision accounts via SCIM or approved directory sync, with offboarding across tenant memberships.
features.control: Suspended users cannot use API tokens, file clients or queued links.
features.acceptance: Directory deactivation blocks all future access within configured synchronization targets.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
features.requirement: Use short-lived access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, device-bound sessions where possible and revocation registries.
features.control: Tokens are scoped to user, client and tenant context; replay is detected.
features.acceptance: A revoked token is denied across all protected services within the defined revocation window.

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices

features.module: Authentication, sessions and trusted devices
